rulesTestNames: shows an alert to the lead holding its duty, never another duty's
lists alerts per duty for a lead and all of them for full reach
read: get and list by an account with the function lead duty for an alert stamped for a duty it holds (a lead lists one duty at a time), and by full reach (coordinators and the owner) for every alert, travel alerts included, while not deleted
write: server only; written from organizerMomentSends, programTravelLegs and programAlerts
migrationNotes: One document per alert; a staff attention alert per run and duty from the earliest send, ending 24 hours after it (clients hide it past expiresAtMillis; documents are not removed by a TTL yet). Carries the assignee's account id so a phone can tell its own alerts; the retention sweep deletes the resolutions, which clears the assignee. The program-live-board-views copy-forward migration creates views for sources that predate the triggers and leaves views the triggers wrote alone.
